claims.statement: Base Mainnet is the production Base EVM-compatible Layer 2 network.

evidence.note: The official Base documentation names Base Mainnet and describes Base as an EVM-compatible Layer 2.

claims.statement: Base Mainnet uses EVM chain ID 8453.

evidence.note: The official Base connection table publishes chain ID 8453.
The fixed-block Base observation independently recorded eth_chainId 8453.

claims.statement: Base Mainnet uses Ether (ETH) as its native gas currency with 18 decimal places.

evidence.note: The official Base connection table publishes ETH as the currency symbol.
The Base-owned pinned chain metadata names Ether/ETH with 18 decimals.

claims.statement: The official Base Mainnet explorer is BaseScan at https://basescan.org.

evidence.note: The official Base connection table publishes the BaseScan URL.

claims.statement: This record exposes only the EVM and Ethereum JSON-RPC capabilities needed by MDK cross-chain workflows.

evidence.note: The official Base documentation describes EVM compatibility and publishes an application RPC endpoint.
The bounded RPC observation establishes the eth_chainId capability used by the current workflow.

limitations: Qualified registry provenance review acceptance covers this chain identity and capability profile only; it does not create provider, bridge-route, protocol, or writer support.
No Base RPC endpoint is selected or supported by this record; the public endpoint documented by Base is explicitly rate-limited.
The EVM profile does not claim every optional JSON-RPC method, archive access, subscription, batching, or provider capability.
